Maria P: Quick sync — enterprise Q4 asks: they want a 12mo pin window for their critical models and an 'escrow' for deprecation where we commit to a migration plan. Can we align on launch gates for cohort A? Need decision by EOD.
Anand R: Can you paste the exact SOW wording? curious if pin window is negotiable. :thinking:
Maria P: pasted from acct: '12 months pin, 6 months escrow support (migration runbook + 2 canaries), rollback credits if SLA missed'
Leah S: For cohort A (fintech), latency constraints are strict. Any pin should include a performance regression SLA. We should add a bench gate: 95th latency <= baseline + 10% and embedding recall >= 98% on canonical promptset.
Tom H: Sounds right. Ops question: do we accept quantized variants as compatible for migration? Some customers only accept fp16.
Anand R: We can define compatibility tiers: Tier 1 (bit-exact/FP16), Tier 2 (quantized with accepted loss). The launch gate should require clear mapping + fallback.
Maria P: Proposal: Launch criteria checklist (short):
- Bench OK: perf/regression gates
- Compatibility matrix signed
- Canaries + rollback playbook
- Customer escrow doc + migration timeline
- Billing/credits clause

Anyone object?
Leah S: Add: eval harness with customer prompts + automated drift alerts. Also require on-call runbook tagged.
Tom H: Ops note: canaries must run in customer's region or dedicated pool. Add traffic caps (5% -> 25% over 48h).
Anand R: Agree. Also want to add an opt-in 'accelerated migration' incentive (1mo credit) to encourage customers to move sooner.
Maria P: Great. I'll draft an 'Entry Brokerage' one-pager with those gates and the SOW snippets. Can someone volunteer to own the one-pager + legal handshake?
Leah S: I can own the one-pager (draft by tomorrow noon).
Anand R: I'll loop in legal and pricing. tagging @Julie - Sales for contract language.
Julie - Sales: Saw the thread — will draft the escrow clause and proposed credits. Quick Q: are we ok with a 60-day notice before deprecation starts?
Maria P: For enterprise, 60d + migration runway seems fine if escrow covers 6mo support. We'll call it out.
ops-bot: Reminder: calendar invite sent for 'Model Entry Brokerage: gates sync' Thu 10:00. :calendar:
Maria P: Thanks — will share draft before invite. TL;DR: agreed checklist + compatibility tiers + canary policy + escrow SOW. Decision target: EOD tomorrow.
